import novamind_api as nm
from collections import defaultdict
day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"===== PROBE WK19 day {day} =====")

# 1. S1-A and S2 new subs by day, last 14 days (start_day cohort)
print("\n--- New subs by day (start_day), last 14d: S1-A vs S2(A+B) ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT s.start_day d, c.group_id g, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
   JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
   WHERE s.start_day > {day-15} AND c.group_id IN ('S1','S2')
   GROUP BY s.start_day, c.group_id ORDER BY s.start_day""")
by = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
for row in r['rows']:
    by[row['d']][row['g']] += row['n']
for d in sorted(by):
    print(f"  day {d}: S1={by[d].get('S1',0):5d}  S2={by[d].get('S2',0):5d}")

# 2. S1 cancellations by day last 14d
print("\n--- S1 cancels by day (end_day), last 14d ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT s.end_day d, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
   JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
   WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day > {day-15} AND c.group_id='S1'
   GROUP BY s.end_day ORDER BY s.end_day""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  day {row['d']}: {row['n']} cancels")

# 3. S2 conversion this week: subscribed vs lost (start_day cohort)
print("\n--- S2 lead outcomes last 7d (start_day) ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT s.status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
   JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
   WHERE s.start_day > {day-7} AND c.group_id='S2' GROUP BY s.status""")
s2sub=s2lost=0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['status']}: {row['n']}")
    if row['status'] in ('subscribed','active'): s2sub=row['n']
    if row['status']=='lost': s2lost=row['n']
print(f"  S2 conv (sub/(sub+lost)) = {s2sub/(s2sub+s2lost)*100:.1f}%" if (s2sub+s2lost) else "n/a")

# 4. S1 conversion this week
print("\n--- S1 lead outcomes last 7d (start_day) ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT s.status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
   JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
   WHERE s.start_day > {day-7} AND c.group_id='S1' GROUP BY s.status""")
s1sub=s1lost=0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['status']}: {row['n']}")
    if row['status'] in ('subscribed','active'): s1sub=row['n']
    if row['status']=='lost': s1lost=row['n']
print(f"  S1 conv = {s1sub/(s1sub+s1lost)*100:.1f}%" if (s1sub+s1lost) else "n/a")

# 5. Historical S1 ad channel effectiveness (days 119-125, when S1 ads were ON)
print("\n--- S1 ad channel eff days 119-125 (ads ON) ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT channel_id, SUM(leads_generated) l, SUM(spend) sp
   FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day BETWEEN 119 AND 125 AND group_id='S1'
   GROUP BY channel_id HAVING sp>0 ORDER BY sp DESC""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['channel_id']:18s}: {row['l']:6d} leads / ${row['sp']:8,.0f} = {row['l']/row['sp']*1000:.1f}/$1k")

# 6. Issue aged tail
print("\n--- Issue backlog age distribution (open) ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT CASE WHEN {day}-open_day<2 THEN '0-1d' WHEN {day}-open_day<5 THEN '2-4d'
   WHEN {day}-open_day<10 THEN '5-9d' ELSE '10d+' END bucket, COUNT(*) n
   FROM issues WHERE resolved_day IS NULL GROUP BY bucket""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['bucket']}: {row['n']}")
r = nm.query(f"SELECT MIN(open_day) o, COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day IS NULL")
print(f"  oldest open_day={r['rows'][0]['o']} (age {day-r['rows'][0]['o']}d), total open={r['rows'][0]['n']}")
# issues opened vs resolved last 7d
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE open_day > {day-7}")
op = r['rows'][0]['n']
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day > {day-7}")
re = r['rows'][0]['n']
print(f"  opened 7d={op}, resolved 7d={re}, net={op-re}")

# 7. S2 quality buffer (delivered vs floor) — get group insights
print("\n--- S2 group insights ---")
try:
    gi = nm.market.get_group_insights(group_id='S2')
    print(gi)
except Exception as e:
